ai_summary: **Executive Summary: AAVAS Financiers Limited Q2FY27 & H1FY27 Earnings**  AAVAS Financiers delivered a strong H1FY27, reporting 16.4% YoY net profit growth driven by robust 30% YoY loan disbursements and significant operational efficiencies, with the cost-to-income ratio dropping to 42.9%. The company achieved substantial productivity gains and maintained industry-leading asset quality (Gross Stage 3 at 1.11%), setting an ambitious long-term AUM growth target of ₹500 billion, supported by strategic branch expansion and increased focus on higher-yield LAP products. While management anticipates increased borrowing costs from recent repo rate hikes, they expect to maintain spreads above 5% and enhance Net Interest Margins, though no immediate adjustment to their Prime Lending Rate has been made, indicating a potential short-term lag in repricing assets.
